relations.text: Intel 4・Intel 3・Intel 18AなどのEUV露光装置はASMLが唯一の供給元(年次報告)
relations.text_en: ASML is the sole supplier of the EUV lithography tools Intel deploys in Intel 4, Intel 3 and Intel 18A (annual report)

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: ASML Holding N.V. (ASML) is currently the sole supplier of EUV lithography tools that we are deploying in our Intel 4, Intel 3, Intel 18A

relations.text: 一部の製品でTSMCの生産能力を利用(年次報告)
relations.text_en: Uses TSMC foundry capacity for various tiles or entire products (annual report)

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we have also strategically utilized third-party foundry manufacturing capacity, including at one of our key foundry competitors, TSMC, for various tiles or an entire product
source.note: TSMCとの長期契約はないと記載しています。
source.note_en: Intel states it has no long-term contract with TSMC.

relations.text: 先端プロセス技術(受託製造)の主な競合としてTSMCを挙げている
relations.text_en: Names TSMC its primary competitor in leading-edge process technology

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitor in leading-edge semiconductor process technology is TSMC, which holds a leading position in manufacturing at scale for the most advanced nodes.

relations.text: 複数年の協業を発表。Google CloudはIntel Xeonなどを引き続き導入(2026年4月、Intel発表)
relations.text_en: Multiyear collaboration; Google Cloud continues to deploy Intel Xeon processors (April 2026, Intel announcement)

source.label: Intel の発表(Intel and Google)
source.quote: Intel Corporation (NASDAQ: INTC) and Google today announced a multiyear collaboration to advance the next generation of AI and cloud infrastructure

relations.text: AWS向けにIntel 18Aでカスタム AIファブリックチップ、Intel 3でカスタムXeon 6を製造する複数年契約(2024年9月)
relations.text_en: Multiyear deal to make a custom AI fabric chip on Intel 18A and a custom Xeon 6 on Intel 3 for AWS (September 2024)

source.label: Intel の発表(Intel and AWS)
source.quote: Intel will produce an AI fabric chip for AWS on Intel 18A, the company’s most advanced process node. Intel will also produce a custom Xeon 6 chip on Intel 3

relations.text: 防衛産業向けの18Aプロセスの顧客として、Microsoftを迎えたとIntelが説明(2024年9月)
relations.text_en: Intel says it onboarded Microsoft among defense industrial base customers for its 18A process (September 2024)

source.label: Intel の発表(Secure Enclave / RAMP-C)
source.quote: Intel has successfully onboarded several defense industrial base (DIB) customers, including Boeing, Northrop Grumman, Microsoft, IBM, Nvidia and others
source.note: 米国防総省のプログラム(RAMP-C/Secure Enclave)の文脈の記載です。
source.note_en: Context is the DoD RAMP-C / Secure Enclave program.

relations.text: Fortinet Security Processor 6で、Intelの設計・パッケージングなどを使う戦略的協業(2026年7月)
relations.text_en: Strategic collaboration on Fortinet Security Processor 6 using Intel design and packaging (July 2026)

source.label: Intel の発表(Intel and Fortinet)
source.quote: Intel Corporation (NASDAQ: INTC) and Fortinet (NASDAQ: FTNT), today announced a strategic collaboration to develop Fortinet Security Processor 6 (SP6).

relations.text: x86のカスタム製品(クライアント向け・データセンター向け)を共同開発する戦略的提携(2025年9月)
relations.text_en: Strategic partnership to co-develop custom client and data center x86 products (September 2025)

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We also announced a strategic partnership with NVIDIA to co-develop custom client and data center products combining our x86 CPU technologies with NVIDIA's AI and accelerated computing capabilities.

relations.text: NVIDIAがIntel株2.15億株を1株23.28ドル・計50億ドルで購入(2025年12月26日完了)
relations.text_en: NVIDIA bought 215 million Intel shares at $23.28 for $5.0B (completed December 26, 2025)

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: on September 15, 2025, we entered into an agreement with NVIDIA to issue and sell to NVIDIA 215 million shares of our common stock at $23.28 per share for an aggregate cash purchase price of $5.0 billion.

relations.text: Intelが年次報告で、データセンター・AI向けGPUシステムの競合としてNVIDIAを挙げている
relations.text_en: Intel’s annual report names NVIDIA among GPU system providers competing in data center and AI

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: providers of GPU systems such as NVIDIA, whose GPU systems have experienced the highest demand in the market as AI workloads have become the dominant source of compute demand

relations.text: Intel株8,700万株を1株23ドル・計20億ドルで購入(2025年9月26日完了)
relations.text_en: Bought 87 million Intel shares at $23.00 for $2.0B (completed September 26, 2025)

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: on August 18, 2025, we entered into an agreement with SoftBank Group to issue and sell to SoftBank Group 87 million shares of our common stock at $23.00 per share, representing an aggregate cash purchase price of $2.0 billion.

relations.text: Intelが普通株の約79.5%・議決権の97.3%を保有(Mobileyeの年次報告)
relations.text_en: Intel beneficially owns about 79.5% of Mobileye’s common stock and 97.3% of voting power (Mobileye annual report)

source.label: Mobileye 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As of December 27, 2025, Intel beneficially owns 50,000,000 shares of our Class A common stock and all of the outstanding shares of our Class B common stock, representing approximately 79.5% of our outstanding common stock

relations.text: AMDとx86エコシステムの諮問グループを設立(2024年10月)
relations.text_en: Formed an x86 ecosystem advisory group with AMD (October 2024)

source.label: Intel の発表(x86 Ecosystem Advisory Group)
source.label_en: Intel press release (x86 Ecosystem Advisory Group)
source.quote: Intel Corp . (INTC) and AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) today announced the creation of an x86 ecosystem advisory group

relations.text: Intelが年次報告で、クライアント向け事業の主な競合としてAMDを挙げている
relations.text_en: Intel’s annual report states AMD is the primary competitor of its client computing business

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: CCG's primary competitor is AMD, which like us designs processors based on the x86 architecture.

relations.text: 12nmプロセスの開発で戦略的に協業(2024年)
relations.text_en: Strategic collaboration to develop a 12nm process platform (2024)

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we announced a strategic collaboration with UMC to develop a 12 nm process platform that expands our mature‑node process portfolio

relations.text: NAND事業をSK hynixへ売却(2回目の取引完了は2025年3月27日)
relations.text_en: Sold its NAND memory business to SK hynix (second closing on March 27, 2025)

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We sold our NAND memory technology and manufacturing business to SK hynix, which we deconsolidated upon closing the first phase of the transaction on December 29, 2021.

relations.text: Intelが年次報告で、Armベースのチップを含む競合としてQualcommを挙げている
relations.text_en: Intel’s annual report lists Qualcomm among platform-product competitors, including Arm-based Snapdragon PC processors

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competitors include companies offering platform products, such as AMD and Qualcomm;

relations.text: AppleがPC向けCPUをIntel製から自社設計のARMベースに置き換えたと記載
relations.text_en: States Apple replaced Intel client CPUs in its PCs with its own ARM-based designs

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: in 2020, Apple introduced PC products utilizing its own internally developed ARM-based semiconductor designs in place of our client CPUs

relations.text: カスタムASICの開発市場でBroadcomと競合と記載
relations.text_en: States it competes with Broadcom in the custom ASIC development market

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We also compete with Broadcom in the custom ASICs development market.

relations.text: 先端の受託製造でSamsungと直接競合と記載
relations.text_en: States it competes directly with Samsung in leading-edge foundry manufacturing

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We also compete directly with Samsung in this market.

note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official announcements and filings (10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, 8-K and prospectuses) are shown. Relationships that could not be confirmed in official materials are left out. This diagram is for organizing information and is not a recommendation to buy or sell any stock.
